scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @ocasio/api && npm run build -w @ocasio/worker && concurrently -k -n api,web,worker "npm run dev -w @ocasio/api" "npm run dev -w @ocasio/web" "npm run dev -w @ocasio/worker"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @ocasio/contracts && npm run build -w @ocasio/database
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @ocasio/api && npm run build -w @ocasio/worker && npm run build -w @ocasio/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @ocasio/api && tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/integration/*.test.ts
scripts.preview: concurrently -k -n api,web,worker "npm run start -w @ocasio/api" "npm run start -w @ocasio/web" "npm run start -w @ocasio/worker"
